# THIS BLOCK IS AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED - DO NOT EDIT IT BY HAND.
    # BEGIN CODE
    codes = []
    label, links = [], []
    m, take_code, take_link, url = None, None, None, None

    def take_code(m):
        codes.append("<code>" + _escape(m.group(1)) + "</code>")
        return _CODE % (len(codes) - 1)

    text = re.sub(r"`([^`]*)`", take_code, text)

    def take_link(m):
        label = _escape(m.group(1))
        url = _escape(m.group(2)).replace('"', "&quot;")
        links.append('<a href="' + url + '">' + label + "</a>")
        return _LINK % (len(links) - 1)

    text = re.sub(r"\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]*)\)", take_link, text)

    def url(m):
        return _escape(m.group(0))

    # END CODE

    for line in str(text).split("\n"):
        if line.strip() == "":
            flush_para()
            flush_list()
            continue
        if line.startswith("- "):
            flush_para()
            items.append(line[2:].strip())
            continue
        flush_list()
        h = _is_heading(line)
        if h:
            flush_para()
            level, body = h
            blocks.append("<h%d>%s</h%d>" % (level, _inline(body), level))
            continue
        current.append(line.strip())
